title: This is the cutest and coolest picnic bag I've had!
text: This is the cutest and coolest picnic bag I've had!. I got this on prime day but seeing the actual price I think it's fairly ok, still, I got the galaxy style one and I just love it so much! It's super pretty and works great! I really like the presentation, it's not very big but it's perfect size for just lunch, drinks or whatever. This is probably the cutest lunch bag I ever had :) Love it so much!
